summary: The call included Karthik Subramanian (CTO), Rahul (AE), Sneha (SE) and referenced Rohan Mehta (Head of Data). Karthik raised concerns about Northwind being a startup versus the enterprise‑grade LensIQ and the ability to handle two billion events per day. Rahul countered with a reference call to a large e‑commerce customer and a two‑week proof‑of‑concept, while Sneha explained the read‑only Kafka integration. The prospect agreed to receive a GPS ingestion pipeline and to set up the reference call, moving the deal forward despite lingering skepticism.

objections.text: LensIQ is enterprise-grade. You're a startup. Why would I bet our SLA platform on you at two billion events a day?
objections.how_handled: Offered reference call with large e‑commerce customer and a two‑week proof of concept to demonstrate performance
